name: pickup_remove_object
description: Pickup::RemoveObject deactivates a pickup node, queues delayed respawns, detaches immediate-removal nodes, and unlinks freed spawns from the primary list.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime/source-cluster pass; the callback/register shape is documented from Binary Ninja but not byte-matched in this session.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41cf50 validates the zEffect callback-compatible fastcall shape, pickup node deactivation, nonzero respawn-delay branch, optional network flag-8 send, PickupRespawnEntry allocation/append, immediate parent removal, optional network flag-2 send, primary-list unlink, and final free behavior.

The native remove-object smoke verifies the respawn queue append/deadline path and the immediate detach/unlink/free path with network disabled; packet flag helpers are covered by their own functional targets.
